approach: Native PC port of the arcade original; one program with a game picker covering Killer Instinct and Killer Instinct 2
help: Native Windows testing of the bundled v1.0.0 build
notes: v1.0.0 published as a pre-release (Windows zip, Linux tarball and AppImage). No game files are included — supply your own arcade ROMs. The bundled Windows build is still awaiting a test on real Windows hardware. Killer Instinct 2 is described in .recomp-2.json in this repository.
